turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Dana, Sara from HyperSale. We cut manager coaching time with AI voice roleplays and quote-backed scoring—can I take 30 seconds?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: You have 30 seconds, but we already have Gong for this.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Totally, Gong reviews calls after they happen; HyperSale lets reps practise realistic buyer conversations before live calls, with every score tied to an exact quote.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: I see the distinction, but my managers don't have time for another tool.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Um, HyperSale runs the roleplays and scores every response automatically, so managers just track week-over-week improvement. Could we pencil a quick look next week?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: That’s still another dashboard my managers won’t open. They don’t have time for another tool.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Um, every score cites the exact rep quote and tracks weekly improvement automatically. Could we maybe reconnect next week?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: My managers still won’t open another dashboard. Send me something by email; I’ve got a meeting, I need to go.
